thesis: Freshworks (Nasdaq: FRSH) sells customer and employee service software. Q3 2026 revenue 245.4M (+14%), GAAP operating income 28.2M (11.5% margin) versus a 7.5M loss a year earlier, 9M GAAP operating income 26.2M, TTM FCF about 236M (GAAP-basis OCF less PP&E and capitalized software), crossed 1B ARR after quarter end, FY2026 revenue guide 965-966M. At 12.08 (2026-11-11 close) market cap is about 3.17B, EV about 2.47B: 2.6x revenue, about 10.5x TTM FCF (7.4% yield), but only 3.7% after deducting SBC of about 118M. Net cash about 696M, no borrowings seen. Cheap on headline FCF; the question is whether SBC-adjusted earnings power and 104% net retention justify a higher multiple. Not shown to be mispriced.
counterthesis: SBC is about 12.6% of TTM revenue and halves the FCF yield; GAAP operating margin is only about 7% TTM; net income is distorted by a 130.4M FY2025 tax benefit; net dollar retention of 104% is flat and customers above 5K ARR grew only 5%; AI-native competition may pressure seat-based service software; stock fell from 13.26 (11-04) to 12.08 after a beat-and-raise-like print (cause not established); buybacks (234.6M 9M) exceed what is needed to offset dilution only modestly; acquisition expense appears in adjustments.
invalidation: Revenue growth below 10%, net retention below 100%, SBC-adjusted FCF turning negative, GAAP operating margin falling back to breakeven, or FCF growth coming only from working capital such as deferred revenue (404M current).
